text:
You're not unlucky. You're missing what others dismiss.

Opportunity doesn't knock. It whispers. It hides in problems. It arrives as the work nobody wants.

Edison's salesmen looked at a dictating machine and saw a dead end. Barnes looked at it and saw an empire. One choice changed everything.

Right now, somewhere in your day, there's a fortune disguised as effort. As a problem you don't want to solve. As work that bores you.

Find it. That's your breakthrough.

Luck is just picking up what everyone else threw away.
caption:
Luck isn't random. Mindset means spotting what others reject. Self improvement is picking it up.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #mindset #selfimprovement #habits #success
